source.run_id_origin: CLI; artifact JSON does not record the GitHub run ID

analyzer.difference: Current local analyzer adds missing-stage null/measured semantics and explicit backend.pipeline=null fallback plus explanations. Counter/timing calculations and acceptance scores are unchanged. Remote analyzer hash is the Git blob, not a hash of its Windows checkout file.

limitations: All discovered attempts are retained, including failed/missing captures and analysis errors. Pass/fail fields and score scalars come from original results without rescoring.
Raw score rows and payload arrays are omitted; original score hashes retain audit references. No global inventory, processes, resource paths, or event documents are copied.
Commit and flush windows overlap and their counts/ratios must not be added. Counters are separately sampled atomics; pending is not an exact balance.
Ratios cover retained spans only. Missing spans mean unmeasured; zero total loss makes a ratio undefined. No checkpoint causality is inferred.
